_about: THE KATANA + FLORA MESHY BATCH 1 (mondo 11-20). Read BATCH1.md first. status: concept -> (mondo OK) -> model -> (mondo OK) -> wired. tris = Meshy target_polycount (triangles, smart-topology).
style: single isolated 3D game prop, stylized realistic, clean simple shapes for a low-poly model, hand-painted look, matte, full object in view, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat light grey background, no ground plane, no shadow, no text, no people

pieces.use: Katana: the bay's big gate; the same model scaled down for the shrine stair's small ones
pieces.prompt: a Japanese Shinto torii gate, two thick round vermilion-red pillars on black stone feet, a straight tie beam (nuki) below a black top lintel (kasagi) that curves up at both ends, a small vertical plaque in the middle with no writing, no rope, no paper streamers

pieces.use: Katana: shrine paths, the temple, the castle garden, the bath house
pieces.prompt: a Japanese stone garden lantern (ishi-doro, kasuga style), grey weathered granite, round post on a hexagonal base, open-sided firebox with empty dark openings, a wide hexagonal roof cap with curled corners and a small jewel finial, moss in the cracks, no light, no flame

pieces.use: Katana: shrine guardians in pairs (mirror one for the other side)
pieces.prompt: a Japanese stone komainu lion-dog guardian statue sitting upright on a square stone plinth, curly mane, open mouth, one front paw on a ball, weathered grey stone with a little moss, no paint

pieces.use: Katana: the fox shrine; a pair beside a small torii
pieces.prompt: a Japanese stone kitsune fox guardian statue sitting upright on a square stone plinth, long bushy tail curled up behind, pointed ears, a small round jewel held in its mouth, weathered grey stone, no cloth bib, no rope

pieces.use: Katana: the temple hall, a hillside niche, the Woods-style shrine
pieces.prompt: a seated stone Buddha statue in meditation, legs crossed, hands resting in the lap, calm face, tight curled hair, sitting on a round lotus-petal stone base, weathered grey-green stone with a little moss

pieces.use: Katana: the bell for the temple's belfry (the belfry stays code-built)
pieces.prompt: a large Japanese bronze temple bell (bonsho), tall barrel shape with a rounded top and a dragon-head loop on top, a grid of raised studs on the upper body, two round striking pads, dark green-brown aged bronze, the bell alone, no frame, no rope, no wooden striker

pieces.use: Katana: in front of every shrine and the temple hall
pieces.prompt: a Japanese shrine offering box (saisen-bako), a wide low wooden chest with a slatted top of angled wooden bars, dark brown wood with black iron corner fittings, a plain front with no writing

pieces.use: Katana: the castle garden pond, the temple stream; walkable (blockers by its own box)
pieces.prompt: a Japanese arched garden footbridge (taiko-bashi), a high half-moon wooden arch over open space, vermilion-red painted railings with round posts and black post caps on both sides, plain wooden plank deck, stone footings at both ends, about six metres long

pieces.use: Katana: ponds; swims in code, so a straight body (no bend)
pieces.prompt: a single Japanese koi carp fish, straight body seen from the side, long flowing fins and tail, white with orange-red and black patches, smooth scales

pieces.use: every pond and lake (Estate lake, Camelot moat, Katana ponds, Fairy Forest); the flat lily pads are code cards, this is the flower
pieces.prompt: a pink lotus flower in full bloom with a yellow centre, sitting on two flat round green lily pads, water plant, the lily pads flat and the flower upright, no water

pieces.use: the Desert, the scrub routes; beside the saguaro and Joshua trees
pieces.prompt: a round barrel cactus, a fat ribbed green globe about knee high, long curved yellow-red spines along the ribs, a small crown of yellow flowers on top, a little sand mound at the base

pieces.prompt: a single clump of young rice plants, many thin upright bright green blades with a few drooping golden grain heads, the roots gathered in one small tuft, no water, no soil
